close_reason: Fixed: added Display impls to ActionMode, SendingMode, DispositionType in jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs
description: ActionMode, SendingMode, and DispositionType implement Serialize (producing wire strings like 'manual-action') but have no Display. Idiomatic Rust: any type that can meaningfully be turned into a string should implement Display. Without it, callers cannot use format\!("{mode}"), and every to-string conversion requires a serde round-trip (as seen in MemoryBackend). Add Display impls matching the serde wire values. All three enums have small, fixed variant sets so the impl is trivial.
title: ActionMode/SendingMode/DispositionType missing Display — violates idiomatic Rust for serializable types
